steps.say: This is a blind auction with two players and five valuable lots. You can talk to your opponent first, then submit secret bids.
Each lot is worth a different amount to each player. Talk to gather clues about what your opponent wants, but remember: you can't see their bids until you submit yours.
When it's time to bid, place secret bids on each lot. The higher bidder on each lot wins it and pays their bid. Your goal is the highest net worth: coins left plus the value of your lots to you.
